purpose: Optional future original-baseline repeatability and matched AIDE research, separate from current single-task reproduction acceptance.

prediction_before_new_runs.execution: Original ForeAgent can produce valid submissions under the frozen setup.
prediction_before_new_runs.score: No assumed reproduction of author mean 0.25862; record all run scores and variability.
prediction_before_new_runs.comparison: Direction and size of ForeAgent versus AIDE effect remain open.

matched_controls: GPU model, CPU quota and detected-core prompt
OCI rootfs and hardware driver versions
code generation model/provider, temperature and output limits
parameter_scale: Both scaffolds are untrained control algorithms. Match code generator and feedback model endpoints/configuration. Record available provider model revision; generated candidate network sizes are outcomes, not fixed scaffold parameter counts.
randomness: Preserve published default behavior. Run numbers are replicate labels, not recovered historical RNG seeds. Capture initial RNG states and software/Python hash environment where possible; log rematch identities in new traces. API sampling and parallel timing prevent exact trajectory guarantees.

budget.rental_fee: GPU unit price times actual billed hours, disclosed before launch
budget.api_fee: Record reported input/output tokens by role and provider billing separately; authorize a concrete spending cap before paid execution.

metrics.primary: Official MCRMSE of original validation-selected final submission, lower is better
metrics.validity: valid submission fraction across all planned attempts
secondary: mean and sample SD across independent runs
provider token usage and billed costs
metrics.unit: Independent online run; candidates and cache reads are dependent observations.

stopping: Published wall-clock cutoff, node cap, explicit user stop, or terminal infrastructure failure. Private scores used after final selection. No automatic extension.
infrastructure_failure_policy: Count every started attempt. Keep partial artifact and interruption record. Report all-attempt results and predeclared uninterrupted subset; replacement runs carry new IDs and require budget approval. Existing network-interrupted v2 stays in historical context, separate from the prospective cohort.
evaluation_guard: Validate required columns, unique complete IDs and finite predictions. Save original CSV hash. Compare pinned scorer to independent ID-joined score. On disagreement retain evidence and stop acceptance until ID order is diagnosed; preserve original scorer source.

entrypoints.native_docker: Pinned mle-bench/run_agent.py using the released named configuration.
entrypoints.autodl_proroot_adapter: Frozen v2 controller/bridge/worker with explicit host/paths and declared execution adaptation. Both upstream configurations passed local zero-call construction; GPU transport and selecting the named AIDE configuration in the deployed adapter are G1 runtime preflight checks.

acceptance: Optional future G2 repeatability / G3 comparative study outcomes. Current reproduction acceptance is complete on the frozen single-task run and local verification.
execution_authorization: Protocol prepared locally. GPU rental, paid APIs and training await a subsequent explicit run instruction.
budget_comparability: Primary comparison matches wall-clock time and hardware. API call counts and token costs may differ as part of the methods; report them separately. A fixed-token/cost comparison requires a separate preregistered estimand.

scope_amendment.basis: User explicitly excludes repeatability and matched AIDE online comparison from current reproduction phase.
scope_amendment.effect: Retain prospective settings for optional future work; no remaining mandatory GPU run for current phase.
